+For every finite atom type, arbitrary complex coefficients with zero total mass, D>=0 and nodes in [0,D], fullR(D,Z,f)=-2*EulerGamma*f(0)-J(D,f,deriv(f)). Absolute continuity supplies the actual a.e. derivative, and original_test_endpoint discharges the endpoint in OriginalSignedJ.fullR_eq_original_J. ActualKernelMomentResolvent.S_global identifies the actual finite-window S_D(t) with this same full-line convolution for every real t. Thus S_D=spectralS(rho A), and actual_spectral_endpoint identifies 4*exp(D/2)*S_D(D) with the original Z=Re(conj(Iplus)*Iminus). No exponential-null or endpoint-S-zero assumption is used. At zero the correlation integral is the prefix energy E, so originalTest(0)=E-W.
+
+Both arithmetic cutoffs are Finset.Icc 2 floor(exp D), and their b functions agree by rearranging the finite sum. Absolute continuity of c and originalTest makes their exponentially weighted functions integrable on the compact interval; subtraction also gives integrability of the weighted S_D. Substitution in actual_fullR_eq_original_J therefore gives signedJExpression=OriginalSignedJ.J(D,originalTest,deriv(originalTest)). These are applications of the existing results, not additional library declarations.
+
+The inclusive endpoint n=exp D is retained: c(D)=0, and its contribution 2*Lambda(n)*S_D(D)/sqrt(n) to V cancels the contribution -Lambda(n)*Z/(2*n) from b(D). This uses Z=4*exp(D/2)*S_D(D), without requiring S_D(D)=0. Empty, repeated and cancelling atom families remain in scope. Applying actual_signed_expression_compensation transports its unchanged D>0, node and moments-through-order(pnt,D) hypotheses to (log(2*pi)-1-EulerGamma)*(E-W)-Re(quadratic(x,a,P))+E <= OriginalSignedJ.J(D,originalTest,deriv(originalTest)). +/-- The L1 spectral resolvent is the exponential convolution of the literal
+complex correlation. Complex correlation slices are integrable only almost
+everywhere; no L2 hypothesis or symmetry of the Fourier density is needed. -/
+theorem spectral_correlation_convolution {A : ℝ → ℂ} (hAm : Measurable A)
+    (hA : Integrable A) (t : ℝ) :
+    OriginalTestRegularity.spectralS (rho A) t =
+      (1 / 4) * ∫ s : ℝ, Real.exp (-|t - s| / 2) *
+        (∫ u : ℝ, star (A (u + s)) * A u).re := by
+  let T : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ × ℝ := fun p => (p.2, p.2 + p.1)
+  have hT : MeasurePreserving T pairMeasure pairMeasure :=
+    measurePreserving_prod_add_swap volume volume
+  let F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => (coefficient A p).re * decay (t + p.1 - p.2)
+  have hF : Integrable F pairMeasure := spatial_real_integrable hAm hA t
+  have hFT : Integrable (F ∘ T) pairMeasure := hT.integrable_comp_of_integrable hF
+  have hCT : Integrable (coefficient A ∘ T) pairMeasure :=
+    hT.integrable_comp_of_integrable (coefficient_integrable hAm hA)
+  have hmap : (∫ p, F p ∂pairMeasure) = ∫ p, F (T p) ∂pairMeasure := by
+    have hm : AEStronglyMeasurable F (Measure.map T pairMeasure) :=
+      hT.map_eq.symm ▸ hF.aestronglyMeasurable
+    simpa only [hT.map_eq] using integral_map hT.measurable.aemeasurable hm
+  have hslice : ∀ᵐ s : ℝ, Integrable (fun u : ℝ => star (A (u + s)) * A u) := by
+    filter_upwards [hCT.prod_right_ae] with s hs
+    simpa only [Function.comp_def, T, coefficient, mul_comm, Complex.star_def] using hs
+  have hprod := integral_prod (F ∘ T) hFT
+  change (∫ p, F (T p) ∂pairMeasure) = ∫ s : ℝ, ∫ u : ℝ, F (T (s, u)) at hprod
+  rw [spectral_convolution hAm hA t, hmap, hprod]
+  have he : (∫ s : ℝ, ∫ u : ℝ, F (T (s, u))) =
+      ∫ s : ℝ, Real.exp (-|t - s| / 2) *
+        (∫ u : ℝ, star (A (u + s)) * A u).re := by
+    apply integral_congr_ae
+    filter_upwards [hslice] with s hs
+    have hre := Complex.reCLM.integral_comp_comm hs
+    simp only [Complex.reCLM_apply] at hre
+    have hp (u : ℝ) : F (T (s, u)) =
+        Real.exp (-|t - s| / 2) * (star (A (u + s)) * A u).re := by
+      dsimp [F, T, coefficient, decay]
+      rw [show t + u - (u + s) = t - s by ring]
+      simp only [Complex.star_def, mul_comm]
+    simp_rw [hp]
+    rw [integral_const_mul, hre]
+  rw [he]
+  ring
+
